kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نغتصب (form VIII)
# نَغْتَصِبُ (naḡtaṣibu) /naɣ.ta.sˤi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# نُغْتَصَبُ (nuḡtaṣabu) /nuɣ.ta.sˤa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# نَغْتَصِبَ (naḡtaṣiba) /naɣ.ta.sˤi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# نُغْتَصَبَ (nuḡtaṣaba) /nuɣ.ta.sˤa.b
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
